title: Professional Certificate in Understanding Potential Investment Decisions and Global Strategies
description: The course explores investment decision prerequisites in a globalised economy.
longDescription: Understanding investment & motives of investment. Understanding the money market, its functions, and its instruments. Understanding investment appraisal and techniques. Understanding global financial management and its objectives. The concept of capital investment, types, and impact of investment appraisal on global financing. Global business activities. Global financial investment strategies. Aspects of global strategy development. The course explores investment decision prerequisites in a globalised economy. The learner will be equipped to make sound investment decisions based on the tools and strategies discussed in this course.
